$schema_note: Deliberate exceptions to scripts/check-brand-bans.mjs. Every entry needs a reason a reviewer can argue with. An entry with only `file` exempts the whole file for that rule; add `line` or `match` to narrow it. Prefer fixing over allowlisting: this file is the record of what the codebase knowingly owes.

gradient.reason: A hard-stop two-colour gradient used as a half-filled dot shape on ProvenanceChip, not a wash. The ban is on gradients as surface decoration; this one draws geometry that would otherwise need an SVG or a pseudo-element. Worth normalising if a shape primitive ever lands.

duration.reason: The spinner. ch.08 permits it as an indeterminate progress indicator; a spinner locked to a 130ms token would not read as continuous.
The spinner slowed under prefers-reduced-motion rather than stopped. A stopped spinner reads as a hang, which is a worse outcome than a slow one.
The skeleton pulse. ch.08 names it explicitly as the only repeating animation in the product, and it stops the moment content arrives.

raw-hex.reason: The .template-preview block simulates résumé paper: a light surface inside a dark-only app, so the --ae-* ramp (calibrated for dark) cannot express it. Scheduled for formalisation as --paper-* tokens alongside the Tailor work, which has the same problem at larger scale.
The A4 schema atlas renders simulated paper on screen and on paper. Same light-surface problem as .template-preview and the same planned --paper-* fix.
Two hexes on .ec-workspace-print__sheet, the print and export mirror of the observatory. Same paper simulation.
